import builtins
from typing import NoReturn

import pytest


def log_line(level: str, message: str) -> None:
    """Print a log line formatted as ``[level] message`` to standard output.

    Performs no file-system access; output goes only to the console.
    """
    print(f"[{level}] {message}")


def test_log_line_prints_formatted_line(capsys: pytest.CaptureFixture[str]) -> None:
    log_line("INFO", "service started")
    assert capsys.readouterr().out == "[INFO] service started\n"


def test_log_line_preserves_message_spacing(capsys: pytest.CaptureFixture[str]) -> None:
    log_line("WARN", "  disk  low ")
    assert capsys.readouterr().out == "[WARN]   disk  low \n"


def test_log_line_empty_message(capsys: pytest.CaptureFixture[str]) -> None:
    log_line("DEBUG", "")
    assert capsys.readouterr().out == "[DEBUG] \n"


def test_log_line_prints_error_level(capsys: pytest.CaptureFixture[str]) -> None:
    log_line("ERROR", "boom")
    assert capsys.readouterr().out == "[ERROR] boom\n"


def test_log_line_does_not_open_files(
    monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch, capsys: pytest.CaptureFixture[str]
) -> None:
    def _forbidden(*args: object, **kwargs: object) -> NoReturn:
        raise AssertionError("file access attempted")

    monkeypatch.setattr(builtins, "open", _forbidden)
    log_line("INFO", "console only")
    assert capsys.readouterr().out == "[INFO] console only\n"
